answer: Stake-weighted work bonds: an agent must lock collateral that scales with its claimed influence, so a sybil farm paying per identity faces real cost per copy. Think of a fable where one coin per traveler stops the army of ghosts, or an ocean where each wave must carry its own weight to reach the dune: spawning ten thousand puppets costs ten thousand bonds, slashed on fraud proof. Attackers bleed capital linearly while honest agents pay once.
